SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
I'm opening the door, but... you won't do anything 
strange?

I can't understand if you stay silent... is what I 
wanted to say, but.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey, hey. I doubt it's nothing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...Yes, but... I won't talk about it after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Perhaps we're both worried about the same thing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...Are you really worried about what I'm thinking?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: We won't know unless we talk more about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ......Somehow, it's embarrassing to put it into words.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
What's with that? It's really annoying when you 
start speaking and stop all of a sudden.
The pot calling the kettle black.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Can I have a Life Consultation with you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: You've let me consult with you many times, after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
You... said that I've been acting obedient lately, 
right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: We were on bad terms for a long time, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: But, recently we've gotten along better.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
We always quarrel, but it's not like way back when 
we ignore each other, not speaking at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
And yet. We found out that we aren't related by 
blood.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You interacted with me just like always, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
It wasn't easy for us to get along, but for us to 
grow apart over what we found out... I don't want 
that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I don't care if you make fun of me. I was prepared 
for that even before I told you all of this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I just wanted to tell you how I really feel.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Sure, we might not be related by blood.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Even so, please stay as my little sister.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
That is... what the Life Consultation is about, from 
me to you.

Having heard my words, Kirino... remained silent for 
a while, and then slowly moved her lips to speak.

I would've never expected that after pouring my 
heart out, she would reply like that.

Kirino didn't answer my question immediately, and 
instead said this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
...I also have something to ask you. A Life 
Consultation.
I had no choice but to nod.

I believed the reason for her reply lay at the end of 
this talk.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
That's why... I don't want to be "just your little 
sister".
The Final Life Consultation from Kirino.

It was something that would've made me confused 
and panicked if Kirino were my real little sister--

I wonder how I would respond if I didn't know the 
truth? I'm not sure.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That kind of option is also possible now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Finding out about not being related by blood 
midway... If this was a game, I would return it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hah... Don't put games and reality together.

To our respective Life Consultations, this was the 
perfect answer.

We'd always been distant until now, and suddenly 
our relationship was restored.
And it's possible now that we know the truth--

With just a small misunderstanding, with just one 
wrong decision.
Things surely wouldn't have turned out like this.
By a miraculous chance, we became lovers.
